column1: # Dataset eval-1.1. Expected verdicts are the dataset author's judgement, not a faculty consensus. Where reasonable reviewers could differ, `accept` lists every verdict that is defensible and `ambiguous` is true; those items are left out of the false-positive and false-negative rates. A faculty panel should review, correct and extend this file before any threshold is set from it.

# Faculty: for each item read source, target and the expected verdict(s); enter your own verdict in facultyVerdict (ALIGNED, PARTIALLY_ALIGNED or NOT_ALIGNED) and a note. Where reasonable reviewers disagree, record that in facultyNotes rather than forcing one answer. Set reviewStatus to "faculty-reviewed" per item only after review; set the dataset reviewStatus to "faculty-reviewed" only when every item has been.
